Both batch-equal and label-weighted MSE preserve validation ranking; there is no demonstrated early-stop implementation bug. The independent official epoch1 control to selected epoch2 difference accounts arithmetically for about 90.7% of this one-case test-MSE gap; the full-run epoch1 weights were not retained, so this is not a strict checkpoint-selection attribution or three-seed D4 explanation. Production early stopping unchanged.
